rows.method:
1. Exploratory factor analysis with varimax rotation to select the items, then analyzed the factor scores of the resulting three-dimensional solution

2. First dimension as the primary analysis, and the second and third dimensions as auxiliary analyses. The second dimension includes: shares, comments, petition shares, reshares of politicians’ content. The third dimension includes: clicks and contacts with Town Hall
